subject: Same model taking minutes versus hours on two different datasets

messages.author: b4c9cafd51003f4b
messages.subject: Same model taking minutes versus hours on two different datasets
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm running the same set of SPDE models for several different countries- the only differences is the observed data and the shape files. The dataset is larger for Malawi (on the order of 6,000 versus 3,000 clusters), but the Uganda models run in minutes, while the Malawi models take hours (I've left one model running for 5 hours this afternoon and it hasn't finished yet). 

Any ideas what could be going on?

Thanks,
Julianne
